risks.risk: DSG High Needs deficit ~GBP 41.4m by 31 March 2026 (from GBP 19.4m a year earlier, accelerating ~GBP 22m/year). NO Safety Valve and NO High Needs Stability Grant agreement; the statutory override that held the deficit off the General Fund ENDED in March 2026. This is the council's single biggest financial risk and dwarfs the GBP 6.8m GF MTFS gap.

General Fund Balance GBP 7.254m is much depleted over recent years (target GBP 12.2m by March 2029); the council inherits a Labour-set budget at +4.99% (the maximum). Reform UK owns delivery from May 2026; the first Reform-set budget is 2027/28.
